name: Build Artifacts
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: 'Release tag to upload assets to (may be a draft), e.g. v26.10.0 or v26.11.0-f8410286-develop'
        required: true
        type: string
      publish:
        description: 'Sign the builds and upload them to the release; false only builds and packages them, unsigned'
        required: true
        type: boolean
      release_repo:
        description: 'Repository under this owner that holds the release (e.g. legacy-develop-builds); defaults to this repository'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      release_app_client_id:
        description: 'Client ID of the GitHub App that can write releases to release_repo; required with release_repo'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
    secrets:
      apple_developer_certificate_p12_base64:
        required: false
      apple_developer_certificate_password:
        required: false
      ac_username:
        required: false
      ac_password:
        required: false
      gh_token:
        required: true
      azure_client_id:
        required: false
      azure_tenant_id:
        required: false
      azure_subscription_id:
        required: false
      release_app_private_key:
        required: false
permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: write
env:
  TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
jobs:
  build_dotnet_mac:
    name: Build dotnet for ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        target: [osx-x64, osx-arm64]
    steps:
      - name: Get the sources
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup dotnet
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      # Cache packages only; restore must still generate each job's build metadata.
      - name: Cache NuGet packages
        uses: actions/cache@v6
        with:
          path: ~/.nuget/packages
          key: nuget-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ matrix.target }}-${{ hashFiles('**/*.csproj', '**/*.props', '**/*.targets', '**/packages.lock.json', '**/[Nn]u[Gg]et.[Cc]onfig', 'global.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            nuget-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ matrix.target }}-

      - name: Clean
        run: dotnet clean --configuration Release

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: dotnet restore -r "${{ matrix.target }}"

      - name: Build
        shell: bash
        run: |
          sed -i '/Scanner/d' ErsatzTV/ErsatzTV.csproj
          dotnet publish ErsatzTV.Scanner/ErsatzTV.Scanner.csproj --framework net10.0 --runtime "${{ matrix.target }}" -c Release -o publish -p:RestoreEnablePackagePruning=true -p:InformationalVersion="${TAG%-develop}-${{ matrix.target }}" -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=false -p:DebugType=Embedded -p:PublishSingleFile=true --self-contained true
          dotnet publish ErsatzTV/ErsatzTV.csproj --framework net10.0 --runtime "${{ matrix.target }}" -c Release -o publish -p:RestoreEnablePackagePruning=true -p:InformationalVersion="${TAG%-develop}-${{ matrix.target }}" -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=false -p:DebugType=Embedded -p:PublishSingleFile=true --self-contained true

      # tar keeps the executable bits that artifact zips drop
      - name: Archive
        run: tar cf "dotnet-${{ matrix.target }}.tar" publish

      - name: Upload .NET Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
